legacy_xgb_recipe_evidence.claim: Known July DIRECT15m screening comparator; not new unseen or V8 qualification

framework.name: Existing quant.research_fast data and cash/NAV accountant
framework.limitation: Predictive long/flat fixed-hold conditional Spot proxy API; not a complete arbitrary benchmark or perp execution framework

shared_period_and_information_set.decision_calendar: common causal availability calendar; decisions may abstain but no strategy may choose evaluation dates from future outcomes
shared_period_and_information_set.perp_or_basis_peer_group: CARRY and any perp candidate need an independent common venue-price/funding/mark/margin/calendar manifest; never transplant Spot PnL
shared_period_and_information_set.feature_availability: all signal inputs <= decision; prior closed values only; event-time and receipt-time distinctions retained
shared_period_and_information_set.future_valid_legacy_endpoints: diagnostic SCREENING only; V8 executable qualification cannot exclude decisions using future label validity

missing_data_policy.decision_inputs_unavailable: abstain and record explicit reason on same calendar; do not silently drop date
missing_data_policy.benchmark_has_insufficient_warmup: whole paired benchmark comparison NOT_EVALUABLE for affected fold; no differing scored windows
missing_data_policy.open_position_valuation_or_settlement_un: NOT_EVALUABLE rather than zero PnL or guessed last/future fill
missing_data_policy.missing_fee_funding_mark_margin_queue: affected venue/scenario NOT_EVALUABLE, metrics null with reason
missing_data_policy.return_labels: no forward fill or substituted endpoint; fit/scoring exclusions recorded separately from feasible decisions
missing_data_policy.common_pairing: hash and audit common eligible calendar and missingness ledger for all paired strategies

shared_capital_and_risk.legacy_enforcement: decision-time budget fixed using past observed net NAV and reserved costs; entry can only shrink for arrival-price/cash/risk; no same-symbol overlapping position
shared_capital_and_risk.market_drift: old caps constrain new entries, not a guarantee drift never exceeds caps; record drift and max exposure, no new risk expansion
shared_capital_and_risk.spot_liquidation_policy: no borrowing or negative cash; if NAV nonpositive report ruin and CAGR=-1, never clip losses or reset capital
shared_capital_and_risk.perp_liquidation_policy: own mark/collateral and historical maintenance/clearance rules required; unknown means NOT_EVALUABLE

fixed_vol_reporting.estimate: past daily UTC gross marked exposure returns only; EWMA span7 completed days, adjust=false, minimum7 days
fixed_vol_reporting.multiplier: min(1, 0.10 / past estimated annual volatility); cash stays cash; no ex-post full-test scaling, no leverage increase
fixed_vol_reporting.execution_time: first feasible arrival after rebalance decision plus cost-contract latency
fixed_vol_reporting.comparison_rule: same causal target/warmup/caps for all risky strategies; disclose underexposure and report raw plus capped-fixed-vol results
fixed_vol_reporting.note: 10pct is a new pre-result reporting convention; it never relaxes frozen30pct/60pct entry caps

benchmarks.rule: retain cash over exact common period; no implicit yield/fees; use common daily UTC reporting and no borrowed capital
enter both once at first common feasible cost-reserved arrival, shrink for fees/caps, hold until common feasible terminal exit; report risk-constrained buy-and-hold, not100pct unconstrained exposure
buy-and-hold directions with shared train/past-only daily EWMA downscaling; residual budget stays cash; all rebalance/terminal costs
use only completed minute closes; evaluate every60s; no outcome-tuned lookback/threshold; fill after actual signal availability and latency
current completed-minute log price vs preceding60 completed minutes, preceding-window mean/std; no test threshold tuning; one position per symbol

parameters.entry: past-only funding estimate conservative lower bound exceeds all roundtrip and basis-risk/uncertainty costs

benchmarks.aggregate_risk_rule: sum absolute spot and perp leg notionals across both symbols <=60pctNAV; each symbol combined legs <=30pctNAV; paired leg failures/unhedged residual explicit
required_inputs: own Spot and perp executable quotes/depth
historical funding events and event mark
current_missing_inputs: historical BBO/depth and executable size model
benchmarks.missing_result_substitute: null; no synthetic positive carry from funding rates alone
benchmarks.reopen_condition: all required inputs, strategy-source/parameter/commit freeze and paired-leg liquidation audit before any economic replay

benchmarks.legacy_reference_role: DIRECT-past-only15m comparator; best known small July development result, not current qualified best

parameters.features: old204 past last/mean/popstd plus6 past-only vol/liquidity/basis fields
parameters.scaler: official sklearn StandardScaler fit on eligible train rows only

benchmarks.old_labels: overlapping-window development diagnostic; not V8 nonoverlap proof
benchmarks.v8_required_adapter: same XGB settings and matched endpoints/features/splits/risk/cost under root LABEL_CONTRACT_V8 DIRECT_RETURN_BASELINE; own new exact source/parameter/commit/artifact binding required

parameters.ensemble_order: net same-venue opposing intents before feasible fills; charge executed turnover once; preserve sleeve attribution

benchmarks.rule: equal fixed ex-ante sleeve risk budgets, no optimizer/test weights; scale only downward and obey30pct/60pct absolute caps including both carry legs
benchmarks.screening_partial_policy: explicitly named PARTIAL_ENSEMBLE_WITH_CASH_FOR_UNAVAILABLE_SLEEVES; same missing sleeve set predeclared for every fold, no pretend full ensemble; do not select sleeve availability by results

statistical_and_benchmark_gate.primary_comparison: cost-after risk-constrained net CAGR increment over strongest feasible risk-matched benchmark on exactly paired common calendar; positivity alone insufficient
statistical_and_benchmark_gate.strongest_benchmark_definition: max paired net CAGR among fully bound evaluable predeclared benchmark peers under identical scenario and risk-target convention; includes cash
statistical_and_benchmark_gate.strongest_missing_benchmark: NOT_EVALUABLE/INCOMPLETE_BENCHMARK_COVERAGE; do not silently remove strong or losing peers
statistical_and_benchmark_gate.strongest_selection_bias: include every benchmark, strategy, parameter, seed, horizon and scenario influencing choices in registry and max-statistic/multiple-testing correction; no unadjusted top-result CI
P1_before_deep_models: at least4 time-dispersed genuinely OOS regimes
paired daily/block-bootstrap net-increment CI not clearly negative
break-even cost near or above preregistered realistic cost
result not concentrated in a few dates/trades
statistical_and_benchmark_gate.P1_numeric_gate_freeze: PENDING_SEPARATE_REGISTERED_RUN_GATE_WITH_ALL_CUTOFFS_BEFORE_RESULTS; no adaptive wording used as an automatic PASS

bootstrap.minimum_block_seconds: max(label horizon, actual maximum holding period, train-estimated dependence horizon); translate upward to whole daily blocks
bootstrap.too_few_independent_blocks: INSUFFICIENT_STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE; not narrow CI from more resamples

multiple_testing_outputs_required: Hansen SPA or White Reality Check
statistical_and_benchmark_gate.current_multiple_testing_implementations: PENDING_IMPLEMENTATION; old descriptive circular mean CI is not full V8 selection correction
statistical_and_benchmark_gate.candidate_trade_gate: lower_confidence_bound(expected_edge) > fee+spread+slippage+execution_uncertainty+model_uncertainty_buffer; fitted only on train/OOF, frozen before test
statistical_and_benchmark_gate.fixed_benchmark_triggers: predeclared comparator rules are evaluated as comparators; they do not bypass candidate_trade_gate to receive candidate qualification
statistical_and_benchmark_gate.deep_model_promotion: P1 plus at least3 fixed seeds counted in trial budget; no test CAGR early stopping

metric_definitions.CAGR: (terminal_settled_NAV/starting_NAV)^(365/calendar_days)-1; report actual cumulative return and days, SCREENING if<=180; ruin=-1; never annualize event-level return/Sharpe
metric_definitions.annualized_volatility: sample std(ddof1) of complete daily UTC net NAV returns *sqrt365; null if fewer than2 daily observations
metric_definitions.maximum_drawdown: largest drawdown of chronological marked NAV including initial capital; disclose daily vs intraday resolution
metric_definitions.Calmar: net CAGR/MDD; null when MDD=0 rather than infinity
metric_definitions.expected_shortfall_95_daily: mean worst5pct daily net returns with explicit empirical quantile convention and small-sample warning
metric_definitions.turnover: absolute executed quote notional over current/period mean NAV with denominator stated; cost on real turnover
metric_definitions.break_even_roundtrip_cost: 2*same-quantity pre-cost cash PnL/two-sided_reference_notional*10000; for funded/borrowed instruments also report funding/borrow-adjusted value; no trades=>null
metric_definitions.capacity_proxy: bound size/participation/depth at actual arrival; unavailable depth=>null with NOT_PROVEN; do not infer capacity from IC or volume alone

every_formal_run_report_order: next gate allowed and machine-readable reasons
required_outputs.unknown_metrics: null plus reason; NOT_EVALUABLE is not zero-return cash or a failed numerical strategy

immutable_run_rule: Specification/source changes use new run receipt/version and append-only decision/trial record; original v6/v7 source/data/evidence never overwritten. Contract hashes and exact strategy-source/parameter/commit must be frozen before outputs are read.
